observations: Direct procedure aliases were consistently correct.
MRI and CT equipment evidence correctly supports the corresponding imaging service.
Renal dialysis equipment evidence correctly supports dialysis service.
One generic migraine-treatment phrase was too broad for the specific antimigraine-agent action.
The exact alias matcher had much better precision than the field-subtype classifier.
conclusion: Use exact canonical action aliases as the primary service-input path. Keep subtype classification and MAxO market estimates as secondary evidence.
